summary: Ameren Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting the completed sale of $900 million principal amount of Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057 under an effective Form S-3 shelf registration. The offering closed September 18, 2026, yielding net proceeds of approximately $891.0 million before expenses. Underwriters, represented by Barclays, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, MUFG, and Truist, acted under a September 8, 2026 underwriting agreement. The filing is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation; no merger, tender, activist, or restructuring event is present.
